# Claude Code adapter

Claude plugin, commands, agents, and skills.

## Local runtime

```bash
npm install
npm start
```

The MCP endpoint is `http://127.0.0.1:8787/mcp`; A2A discovery is `http://127.0.0.1:8787/.well-known/agent-card.json`. Load `skills/core/kernel/using-forge-os/SKILL.md` before starting a ForgeOS run. Treat this adapter as project-local integration evidence, not a claim that the upstream platform has certified ForgeOS.
